title: The error-boundary state renders on a client-side render failure with a role=alert announcement
asA: operator hitting a client-side render exception
iWant: the error-boundary state to render inside role="alert" with a retry recovery hook and no stack detail
soThat: the assistive tech announces the failure immediately (assertive, not polite) and I have an escape from a broken render

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a synthetic client-side render exception thrown via page.evaluate (or the sample-app /probe/error-boundary?crash=1 route), the error-boundary state renders inside role="alert" with a keyboard-reachable [data-recovery="retry"] control, a plain summary line and no stack-frame content matching the sensitive-pattern list. The pack drives /probe/error-boundary?crash=1, reads the region, the retry control and the document text for pattern hits.
